executiveSummary: GM0177 passes the complete deterministic ten-preset, six-checkpoint and eight-service contract. Its CBS/PDOK 2025 identity, 38,623-person municipality control, 38 neighbourhoods in nine districts, nine BAG places, twelve BRT settlements, Raalte and Heino rail stations, 62 scheduled-transit stop areas and six domestic NWB logical links are coherent; rounded neighbourhood rows sum to 38,630, only seven above the separately published control (+0.018%). Release is nevertheless correction-required. One contained regional LIWO candidate confirms a possible regional-water pathway, but the river preset reports an exact 1.275463 m depth-like value from T+12 through T+72, 15,354 affected resident-equivalents at T+24 and 1,229,239.555 deprived person-hours at T+72 without selecting an active breach/overtopping case, water boundary, connected footprint, arrival or recession. Nine unrelated presets reuse the same complete 38-neighbourhood hazard order at T+24. A controlled ignition inside the official Boetelerveld combustible-nature polygon and Buitengebied Mariënheem produces direct flame/smoke, yet its source neighbourhood ranks twelfth. The road graph omits the N35 through Raalte even though the province identifies its N35/N348 junction as unsafe and capacity-constrained. Public context assigns 197 water/wastewater objects, one Heino weather observation, one Enexis planning sample, 74 antenna sites and 33 education locations, while no RIVM acute-care respondent lies inside GM0177; none of those sources establishes complete live topology, occupancy, flow, backup, acceptance, staffing or restoration. Unknown, NoData, candidate catalogues, plans, registers, schedules and static observations must never become zero, safe, open or operational.

evidenceSources.publisher: Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek / PDOK / Kadaster
evidenceSources.title: E01 — GM0177 official 2025 municipality, neighbourhood, place, settlement and safety-region context
evidenceSources.edition: CBS Wijken en buurten 2025; generated snapshots retrieved 31 August–2 September 2026
supports: Annual CBS/PDOK inputs identify GM0177 as Raalte in Overijssel and safety region IJsselland and report 38,623 residents, density 226/km², 25.1% aged 65 or older and 5,078 one-person households; the generated centre [6.273529069176905,52.379296880173115] lies inside the 2025 boundary.

Thirty-eight neighbourhood rows in nine districts sum to 38,630 residents, seven above the separately rounded municipality control (+0.018%); households sum to 16,480 and independently rounded age-65-plus rows to 9,700. Allocation reconciles to the municipality control without rewriting published observations.

BAG supplies nine places—Broekland, Heeten, Heino, Laag Zuthem, Lierderholthuis, Luttenberg, Mariënheem, Nieuw Heeten and Raalte—and BRT supplies twelve source-labelled settlements: nine woonkernen and three buurtschappen. No generated BAG place centre falls outside the municipality.

CBS exposes all 36 requested regional fields. District heating and public charging are null in all 38 rows; cars per household is null in four, home-value and several housing/benefit fields in two, and doctor/supermarket distance in one. CBS/PDOK is CC BY 4.0 and BAG is Public Domain Mark 1.0; source null/suppression remains NoData rather than zero.

evidenceSources.title: E02 — Municipal sewer, rainwater, groundwater and climate-adaptation responsibilities
evidenceSources.edition: Programme budget 2025 and multi-year estimate 2026–2028; GRP 2021–2030; current project pages inspected 3 September 2026
supports: The municipality's GRP 2021–2030 distinguishes gravity sewer in the settlements and pressure sewer in the rural area, pumping wastewater to water-board treatment plants, and municipal collection, storage and infiltration of rainwater. Those pathways cannot be represented by one unsupported municipal inundation scalar.

The budget records intensive rainfall as current reality, a final pressure-sewer renovation phase, a separated system in Dorpsstraat/Zwolseweg in Heino and increasing failure risk from ageing sewer assets. Policy and planned works are not proof of completed capacity, event-time condition or operation.

The official Raalte/Heino growth vision identifies more frequent extreme-rain nuisance and distinguishes generally modest heat stress from higher heat around the centres and De Zegge because of hard surfaces and flat roofs. The current Heino-Zuid project separately studies extra rain sewer and measures for rain, drought and heat.

Municipal PDFs and project pages are public administrative evidence with document/project dates, but no standard machine-event cadence, native stress-test surface or blanket redistribution licence was identified. They support mechanism review, not exact T+0–T+72 depth or performance.

evidenceSources.publisher: Waterschap Drents Overijsselse Delta / Het Waterschapshuis
evidenceSources.title: E03 — Salland water-system programme and public water/wastewater object context
evidenceSources.edition: Waterbeheerprogramma 2022–2027; HWH deployment snapshot retrieved 2–3 September 2026
supports: The official Salland area programme distinguishes extreme rain, drought, storage, groundwater, water supply, water quality, managed levels and the regional watercourses Nieuwe Wetering, Overijssels Kanaal Deventer, Soestwetering, Westerveldse Aa and Raalterwetering. These are separate catchments and controls, not a uniform neighbourhood field.

The programme names RWZI Heino discharging to Nieuwe Wetering and RWZI Raalte to Hondemotswetering, and identifies Raalte as a RIVUS wastewater-chain partner. A named chain is eligibility/context, not a live flow, pump, treatment, backup or discharge observation.

Full-boundary containment assigns 197 HWH objects to GM0177: eleven sewer pumps, eleven surface-water pumps, RWZI Heino, RWZI Raalte and 173 weirs. All 22 pump records have a numeric source capacity, but the units/functions are not a complete connected hydraulic model; register status is not live operation.

HWH IMWA/DAMO is contributor-dependent and partial, weekly where supplied and CC BY-SA 4.0. Object presence, capacity and source status do not establish catchment, connectivity, compatible flow units, receiving level, telemetry, blockage, power/backup, control sequence or restoration.

evidenceSources.title: E04 — LIWO 2025.1.6 breach-candidate catalogue for the Raalte boundary
supports: The bounded regional-candidate query returns six points, but point-in-polygon against the full generated municipal boundary contains only Nieuwe Wetering Zuid West at [6.1681,52.4702], coded REG with openwaters_id 90 and a 30–300-year frequency-class flag. Bbox-only points outside GM0177 were not assigned.

The corresponding primary-candidate query returns no point inside or in the municipality bbox. Zero primary candidate points does not mean zero flooding, because regional, pluvial, groundwater, sewer and receiving-water pathways remain distinct.

Candidate points and frequency flags are scenario-selection metadata, not an active breach, forecast, connected inundation footprint, physical metre depth, arrival, velocity, duration or recession. Operational use must pin release, boundary/datum, defence/control state, footprint, units, CRS/resolution, uncertainty, coverage, NoData, licence and authority approval.

The cached Waterinfo observation and forecast snapshots assign zero records to GM0177. That is no contained reporting point in the snapshot, not zero water, a safe regional system or a complete evidence gap outside the source's point coverage.

evidenceSources.title: E05 — N35/N348 Raalte junction, NWB road graph, rail stations and scheduled transit
evidenceSources.edition: Current provincial project page; NWB-Light 1 August 2026; ProRail snapshot and GTFS v9543 valid 30 August–12 December 2026
supports: The province says the current N35/N348 junction at Raalte has insufficient throughput and unsafe conditions. A possible grade-separated reconstruction and station cycle tunnel are under development for 2026–2030; a plan is not a current closure, final geometry or event throughput.

The generated monthly CC0 NWB graph has six logical Raalte links—N348 to Dalfsen and Olst-Wijhe, N756 to Olst-Wijhe, N835 to Dalfsen and Hellendoorn, and N332 to Rijssen-Holten—but no N35 link west or east. Nominal 150 values are scenario units and secondary routes cannot silently substitute for the omitted corridor.

ProRail supplies Raalte and Heino stations and GTFS assigns 62 stop areas. Static station/stop geometry and feed-valid schedules do not establish passengers, accessibility, rolling stock, train/bus operation, emergency role or evacuation capacity.

The cached NDW snapshot assigns zero current situations to GM0177. This is no matching covered record at snapshot time, never proof that N35/N348, local roads, level crossings, rail or transit are open. NWB and ProRail are CC0; route, register, schedule, project and timestamped status remain separate evidence classes.

evidenceSources.publisher: Provincie Overijssel / IPO-BIJ12 Risicokaart / Veiligheidsregio IJsselland
evidenceSources.title: E06 — Boetelerveld combustible-nature eligibility, restoration measures and nature-fire context
evidenceSources.edition: Current Natura 2000 page; Risicokaart metadata updated 19 February 2026; feature validity from 26 February 2010
supports: The province describes Boetelerveld as a 171 ha Natura 2000 area, about one-third wet heath with pools, and explicitly identifies excessive dryness; current measures include removing conifers, planting deciduous woodland, blocking ditches and adjusting water management. Restoration intent is not current fuel/moisture or protection performance.

The public Risicokaart WFS identifies 'Natuurreservaat Het Boetelerveld' as a mixed-forest/heath combustible-nature polygon, feature isor_brandbaar_natuurgebied.0177200518512, supplied by Raalte. Point [6.325,52.363] lies inside that polygon and official neighbourhood BU01770309 Buitengebied Mariënheem.

Risicokaart's public-domain polygon and the provincial nature page establish local nature-fire eligibility and coupled drought/water-management context, not an ignition, current fuel load/moisture, perimeter, wind/plume, visitor occupancy, access, extinguishing water, suppression or recovery.

The safety region's public nature-fire guidance recognizes rapid escalation after dry periods in forest, heath and rough grass. It is regional preparedness/context without a machine incident feed or local event state.

evidenceSources.title: E07 — External acute-care destinations and static multimodal access context
evidenceSources.edition: RIVM acute-care v1.1 published 3 July 2026; transport snapshots retrieved 2–3 September 2026
supports: RIVM acute-care v1.1 is a CC0 static questionnaire. It assigns no respondent emergency-department point inside GM0177; nearest to the municipal centre are 24/7 Deventer Ziekenhuis at 14.21 km and Isala Zwolle at 18.04 km, both reporting acute obstetrics. Straight-line distance is not an ambulance route or live acceptance state.

Raalte's 38,623 residents include 25.1% aged 65 or older, but annual demographic proportions do not identify home medical-device dependence, care-client location, individual mobility, current patients, staff or incident-specific demand.

Six static road links, two stations and 62 stop areas do not route to external acute-care destinations or prove route, rail or bus operation. Live ambulance availability, travel time, diversion, acceptance, beds, staffing, backup utilities and patient transfer remain Unknown.

The survey and transport registers/schedules support dated destination and accessibility review only. They cannot substantiate exact Facilities/Mobility availability, affected population, evacuation throughput or T+72 recovery.

evidenceSources.publisher: KNMI / Netbeheer Nederland / Enexis / RDI / DUO / RIVM / Rijkswaterstaat
evidenceSources.title: E08 — Public weather, electricity-planning, antenna, education, seismic, air and water context
evidenceSources.edition: Deployment snapshots retrieved 2–3 September 2026; RIVM acute-care v1.1 published 3 July 2026
supports: One contained KNMI station observation at Heino is valid 2 September 2026 23:30Z: 16.8°C, 88% humidity, 2.8 m/s wind, 4.41 m/s gust and zero hourly rain/intensity. KNMI 10-minute observations are CC BY 4.0 sparse point context and are not the simulator's scenario forcing or a municipal surface.

One sampled postcode, 8102JH, maps to Enexis RT Raalte and reports planning values of 53.5 MW existing/55.2 MW required withdrawal with 6.6 MW queued, and 53.0 MW existing/82.6 MW required injection with 15.0 MW queued, plus thirteen projects. The map is updated at least quarterly and queues monthly; its exact dataset licence identifier is unstated. It is not live load, topology, outage, switching, reserve or restoration.

RDI assigns 74 sites/161 antennas: 34 mobile sites/102 antennas, fifteen fixed-link/33, 21 amateur/22, three other-mobile/three and one broadcast/one. DUO assigns 33 education uses: twenty primary, five secondary, one special and seven other registered. Points do not establish coverage/backhaul/power, occupancy, shelter role, staffing, stocks or operation.

The deployment assigns zero KNMI seismic-origin, RIVM PM2.5 station, Waterinfo and NDW matches to GM0177. Each zero is no record in that source/scope, not zero seismic hazard, air pollution, water condition or disruption. All cited public-context layers remain affectsSimulation=false.

evidenceSources.title: E09 — Current regional crisis-plan, addendum and response-governance context
evidenceSources.edition: Crisisplan 2023–2026 with addendum adopted 10 December 2025; listed as current 3 September 2026
supports: The current crisis plan and addendum define incident-driven command, information, population-care, evacuation/reception, medical, mobility and recovery roles across IJsselland. This is organisational planning evidence, not activation or performance in a particular Raalte incident.

Public plan availability does not establish warning receipt, water-system inspection/control, road/rail status, evacuation, shelter, care acceptance, utility backup, resupply, dewatering, repair or restoration at any simulator checkpoint.

The public pages do not expose a complete machine action/resource/decision-state feed, guaranteed operational update cadence or standard redistribution licence. Plans support governance labels but not exact resource counts, completion times or service percentages.
Model checkpoints should therefore cite incident-valid decisions and resources separately from standing plans and preserve unavailable operational state as Unknown.

findings.summary: Official observations, candidates, plans, registers, schedules and no-match results are not consistently evidence-gating model precision.
findings.evidence: The context correctly marks public layers non-causal: one dated Heino observation, one postcode-level Enexis planning sample, 197 water objects, 74 antenna sites, 33 education uses and zero contained Waterinfo, NDW, PM2.5 or seismic records. findings.action: Carry publisher/version, evidence class, issue/valid time, spatial/system coverage, licence, NoData mask and reason code through ingestion, model, UI and export. Absence never means zero hazard, open route, operational service or safety.

Request Raalte/GHOR/VRIJ/transport/land-manager aggregates for current people, accessible destinations, role/activation, staffing/capacity range, patient needs, acceptance/diversion, shelter and transport. Zero internal RIVM respondents and absent counters remain NoData, not zero care or visitors.

corrections.summary: Evidence-gate all other local hazard/service precision and first-72-hour recovery.
corrections.validation: Exact magnitude, ranks, affected population, service consequences and exports require hazard/service support with publisher/version, evidence class, issue/valid time, geometry/system boundary, coverage, licence, uncertainty and NoData. Each checkpoint plateau/deterioration/restoration cites an owner, target, prerequisite, crew/material/fuel/water, route access, start/end and observed/planned/completed state. Distinguish observations, forecasts, candidate scenarios, plans/registers and synthetic exercise values.

residualLimitations: This artifact audits a deterministic first-72-hour exercise model, not a forecast, warning, evacuation instruction, hydraulic assessment, road/rail operating decision, hospital status or operator restoration commitment.

CBS 2025 values are rounded/suppressed and residents exclude commuters, pupils, patients, staff, transit users, nature/event visitors, responders and displaced people; no timestamped dynamic occupancy is consumed.

Generalized administrative polygons and centroids cannot resolve regional-water compartments, sewer/groundwater catchments, pumps/weirs/controls, combustible vegetation, road/rail access or utility zones.

The one contained LIWO regional point is a candidate, not a breach, forecast or footprint. Bbox queries include outside points unless polygon-filtered, and its frequency flag is not current probability, water level, depth or arrival.
Zero contained Waterinfo points is a source-coverage result. It does not establish absence of relevant upstream/downstream observations, a regional-water boundary or safe conditions.

Municipal GRP, budget, growth vision and project pages establish responsibilities and planning, not a live rain event, heat field, groundwater surface, sewer/pump condition, completed measure or local depth.

The controlled Boetelerveld source is synthetic. Official vegetation and restoration context does not establish current fuel moisture, ignition, perimeter, wind/plume, visitors, access, extinguishing water, crew or suppression.

NWB, ProRail and GTFS are static/register/schedule evidence. The current province page establishes a N35/N348 bottleneck and future project, not live road/rail/transit operation or emergency throughput.

RIVM's zero internal acute-care respondent points does not erase local care or demand. Centre distance to Deventer/Isala is not route time, ambulance availability, live acceptance, beds, staff, utilities or backup.

HWH coverage is partial/provider-dependent. Registered object, type, capacity or status does not establish connected topology, current operation, compatible flow units, power/backup, control sequence or recovery.

One NBNL postcode sample, RDI antennas, DUO schools and one Heino weather station are planning/register/point-observation context. They do not establish customer connectivity, occupancy, load, signal, municipal weather surface, outage, reserve or repair.

Complete physical electricity, gas, drinking-water, wastewater, telecom, care, supply and emergency-resource topology/live state may be unavailable or security-sensitive and remains Unknown or explicitly synthetic.

Exact hazard, neighbourhood, affected-population, service-availability, recovery and person-hour values remain synthetic/derived screening until critical/high findings are corrected and authorities review the selected event; impacts beyond T+72 are outside scope.

GM0177-WATERCHAIN-UTILITIES-001 — Province, municipality, WDOD, RIVUS, Vitens, Enexis, gas and telecom partners should define privacy/security-safe topology, live-state and restoration interfaces; public assets/planning samples remain non-causal.
